results.title: Private jet users in Scotland should face 'punishingly high' taxes, demand campaigners
results.description: John Swinney has promised action on private jets and campaigners are now calling for him "to prove he means business" on the issue.

results.title: Scottish Labour leadership candidate under fire over cuts to free school buses for pupils
results.description: EXCLUSIVE: Joe Fagan's administration in South Lanarkshire pushed through a cut that scrapped the eligibility for free transport for over 1,000 pupils.
